instances.claim: This tells me that the value of the work is detached from the object and perpetually re-decided — and then tells me so twice more without adding a level at which that happens.
instances.why: Line 16 makes the point at the level of mechanism (value decoupled from the object, held instead by social consensus); 17 restates the same proposition in abstract synonyms ("indeterminate and continually redefined"), and 18 restates it again with the artist as subject ("an ongoing process of redefinition") — shared roots redefined/redefinition/consensus mark the loop, and neither 17 nor 18 moves to the object, the audience, or the form. Keep 16, which carries the mechanism; 19 and 20 then supply the object and form registers, so cutting 17 and 18 loses no level.
